summary: Enable Dedicated Burst Capacity beta for customer tenant (Northpeak Search) in us-east (H100)
description:
Request
- Enable Dedicated Burst Capacity (beta) for customer tenant: Northpeak Search
- Region / HW class: us-east / H100 burst pool
- Requested window: 2025-05-07 to 2025-05-21 (indexing jobs; weekly predictable spikes)

Customer / account context
- Customer tier: Dedicated (mid-market)
- SE owner: Simran Kaur
- CS owner: Miguel Santos
- Primary use case: batch indexing + query-time reranking; wants baseline reserved capacity with temporary 1.5–2.0x bursts.

Tenant details (from SE)
- tenant_slug: northpeak-search-prod
- tenant_id: tnt_8f3c1b2e (confirm in control plane before applying)
- Dedicated cluster: ded-us-east-17
- Routing mode: Smart Routing enabled (dedicated tier)

Approvals required (beta policy)
- Product (Dedicated) approval: Lauren Bishop
- Fleet capacity confirmation (pool headroom): Vanessa Ortiz
- SRE sign-off (SLO gates + rollback): Sean Gallagher
- Finance approval not required for beta enablement (per PM-541), but metering must be on.

Requested configuration (beta defaults unless noted)
- burst_enabled: true
- burst_pool_scope: shared Redwood-managed pool (us-east/H100)
- max_burst_ratio: 1.75x baseline (cap)
- per_tenant_burst_gpu_cap: 8 GPUs (additional above baseline)
- cooldown_window_seconds: 900 (15 min) after sustained cap hit
- priority_tier: silver (default)
- deny_behavior: immediate deny with reason code (no queueing) + client retry guidance
- metering: enabled (export to billing pipeline; marked beta)
- audit_logging: enabled for all config changes and overrides

Rollout / execution checklist
1) Confirm region/hardware allowlist enabled for burst beta (feature flag: burst.enable_by_region_hw = us-east/H100).
2) Confirm global kill-switch remains OFF (burst.global_disable = false) and SLO regression gate is configured for non-burst tenants.
3) Update tenant config in control plane with burst settings; validate schema + limits.
4) Verify admission controller sees config within propagation window (<5m).
5) Verify routing/gateway surfaces denial reasons (if any) and does not fallback across region.
6) Validate dashboards for tenant: burst usage, denials, saturation, telemetry lag.
7) Notify SE/CS that enablement is complete; provide dashboard links + expected behaviors.

Risk notes
- Customer previously flagged sensitivity to 429s during peak. Please ensure deny reason code mapping is correct and retry guidance is included in SE handoff.
- Must preserve neighbor SLOs; if p95 latency delta for non-burst tenants exceeds gate thresholds, SRE may reduce cap or disable burst.

Success criteria (beta)
- Customer can achieve target throughput during indexing bursts without increasing baseline reservation.
- Denial rate < 5% during expected burst windows (excluding intentional cap hits).
- No sustained non-burst p95 regression in us-east/H100 fleet correlated with this tenant.

Handoff / comms
- Once enabled, please post confirmation in #customer-success and #eng-sre with tenant_id, cap settings, and rollback plan.
comments: 2025-05-06 10:14 PT — Markus Klein (Reporter): Creating ticket per beta onboarding sync. Northpeak wants burst enabled before their Wed indexing run. Simran/Miguel are aligned. Need Product/Fleet/SRE approvals per checklist in PM-541.

2025-05-06 11:02 PT — Lauren Bishop (Product): Approved for beta enablement under default silver tier. Keep max_burst_ratio <= 1.75 for first week; we can revisit after we have denial/latency data. Please ensure metering is enabled and customer sees usage in Console.

2025-05-06 11:18 PT — Vanessa Ortiz (Fleet): us-east/H100 burst pool has headroom this week. OK to proceed with +8 GPU tenant cap. If we see pool saturation >80% during their window, we may need to lower caps temporarily (runbook).

2025-05-06 11:41 PT — Sean Gallagher (SRE): Approved with conditions: (1) SLO gate enabled for non-burst tenant p95 delta; (2) confirm global circuit breaker alerts are wired; (3) notify #eng-sre when enablement is live. If we trip the gate, we will disable burst first and follow up with customer.
2025-05-06 12:09 PT — Benji Okafor (Assignee): Acknowledged. I’ll confirm allowlist + apply tenant config. Targeting completion by EOD today; will include audit log event IDs in completion note.

2025-05-07 09:26 PT — Benji Okafor (Assignee): Pre-checks: us-east/H100 allowlist is ON; global kill-switch is OFF. Verified admission-controller healthy in us-east. Proceeding with tenant config update for tnt_8f3c1b2e.

2025-05-07 09:41 PT — Benji Okafor (Assignee): Tenant config updated: burst_enabled=true, max_burst_ratio=1.75, per_tenant_burst_gpu_cap=8, cooldown=900s, priority=silver. Audit events emitted: BURST_ENABLED, BURST_LIMITS_UPDATED (see audit log search with tenant_id). Propagation confirmed in admission controller within ~2m.

2025-05-07 10:05 PT — Benji Okafor (Assignee): Validation: routed a canary load test (internal) against dedicated endpoint; observed burst admission working and denial reasons surface correctly when cap hit (BURST_TENANT_CAP_REACHED). Metering export shows burst_gpu_seconds > 0 for test run (marked beta).

2025-05-08 16:11 PT — Sean Gallagher (SRE): Observed during first burst window: pool saturation peaked 62%, non-burst p95 delta within gate. No action required.
2025-05-08 16:20 PT — Benji Okafor (Assignee): Marking resolved. If Northpeak requests higher cap/ratio, please open a follow-up INT ticket and tag Fleet + SRE for re-approval.
resolution: Burst beta enabled for Northpeak Search tenant in prod us-east/H100 with approved guardrails (1.75x ratio, +8 GPU cap, 15m cooldown). Verified propagation, dashboards, denial reason surfacing, metering export, and audit logging. Monitoring established with SRE; rollback plan communicated.
next_steps: CS/SE to review burst usage + denial breakdown after first full week; propose tuning if needed (new INT ticket).
If customer experiences unexpected denials or 429 behavior, route to Support ticket and link back to INT-9132 for config history.
